notes.title: FAMILY MAN IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]It's been a long 5-year road, but Family Man is OUT NOW! Time to take control of Joe Hawthorn's life and become a FAMILY MAN! [/h1]

[previewyoutube=3MwitSPFhNw;full][/previewyoutube]

We're so excited to finally launch, and we hope you love it as much as we do! Whether you turn Joe into a hardened criminal or a wholesome town help - we can't WAIT to see how you get on! You'll be working with some of Riverport's LIVELIEST characters and your choices will determine their fates. Be careful and make some good decisions (then come tell us all about them in the [url=discord.gg/familyman]Discord[/url]!)

As ever, if you run into any trouble or bugs, feel free to reach out to us! 

Good luck Joe, you'll need it! 

Broken Bear Games & No More Robots xoxo

notes.title: Family Man launches THIS FRIDAY! Enjoyed the Prologue? Please leave a review!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone! 

We're so glad everyone has enjoyed playing the Prologue, can you believe there are only 4 days left until Family Man launches?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37648399/c1cb6773aa64643faac89fea2d511fb5fee98083.png[/img]

If you've enjoyed our Prologue, [b]please consider leaving a review[/b] - they help us a ton, and we love reading them! It's been great hearing what you're looking forward to in the main game! 

We'll see you on the 22nd - If you have any questions don't forget to join us over on the Discord - [url=discord.gg/FamilyMan]discord.gg/FamilyMan[/url]

Much Love!

Broken Bears Games & No More Robots xoxo[/h3]
